summary: Phase 7 iteration 4 tested. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py — /api/settings/public exposes both public_signup_enabled+upload_policy; PUT /api/admin/settings toggles upload_policy (admin_only) and enforces 403 on /api/knowledge/upload for demo user, then restores to client_self_serve; POST /api/admin/users/{demo_uid}/files/upload accepts mini PDF and returns uploaded_by_admin=true; DELETE /api/admin/files/{id} soft-deletes and record disappears from /api/admin/users/{uid}/files listing; /api/admin/health returns all new fields (ses,telnyx_configured,telnyx_can_call,telnyx_phone,google_oauth) — all false as expected with empty env keys; /api/google/oauth/start returns 400 with 'Google OAuth not configured'; /api/google/status returns {connected:false}; /api/chat/escalate returns call_status='mocked', provider='mock' and inserts db.calls row; /api/booking/confirm returns google_calendar_url starting with google.com/calendar/render and google_event_id=null; PUT /api/me/profile avatar_background='office' persists on GET /api/me. Frontend: Landing / renders particle canvas (canvas.pointer-events-none present, 0 console errors); demo login→/dashboard OK; Branding tab avatar-bg-grid + avatar-bg-{studio_dark,office,clean_gradient} present, clicking office sets green border rgb(72,187,120); Matrix tab gcal-card + gcal-connect-btn visible; open-setup-btn navigates to /setup which renders guide-shopify, guide-wordpress, guide-html, universal-snippet, copy-universal-snippet; admin login→/admin OK; Clients tab (data-testid admin-tab-clients) shows btn-files-demo@client.com which opens dialog with admin-files-upload-zone + admin-files-upload-input. ISSUE: Admin Overview tab has NO upload-policy-group / upload-policy-client / upload-policy-admin UI although the React state (uploadPolicy) and handler (setUploadPolicy) are defined in Admin.jsx (lines 24, 43, 53). The JSX render block for the toggle group is missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Upload-policy toggle UI is missing – React state (uploadPolicy) and setUploadPolicy handler are declared but never rendered. Expected 3 elements with data-testid='upload-policy-group', 'upload-policy-client', 'upload-policy-admin'. Current count for each is 0. Users cannot toggle the upload_policy from the admin UI (only via direct API).

backend_tests_passed: PUT /api/admin/settings upload_policy=admin_only → GET reflects; demo /api/knowledge/upload returns 403; restore to client_self_serve → 403 no longer returned
GET /api/admin/health includes ses/telnyx_configured/telnyx_can_call/telnyx_phone/google_oauth (all false with empty env - correct)
GET /api/google/oauth/start → 400 with detail 'Google OAuth not configured'
frontend_tests_passed: / Landing renders particle canvas (canvas.pointer-events-none present), 0 console errors
tab-branding: avatar-bg-grid with avatar-bg-studio_dark/office/clean_gradient present; click office → green border (rgb(72,187,120))
/setup renders guide-shopify, guide-wordpress, guide-html, universal-snippet, copy-universal-snippet
admin-tab-clients (note actual testid) → btn-files-demo@client.com opens dialog with admin-files-upload-zone + admin-files-upload-input
action_items: Admin.jsx (Overview tab): render the upload-policy toggle UI. Add a section similar to the 'Toggle Public Signup Page' card, containing a container div data-testid='upload-policy-group' with two buttons data-testid='upload-policy-client' (label 'Client self-serve') and data-testid='upload-policy-admin' (label 'Admin only'). Wire onClick to existing setUploadPolicy('client_self_serve'|'admin_only'). Highlight active state based on uploadPolicy state variable so testing agent can verify visual toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx: uploadPolicy state/handler declared (lines 24, 43, 53) but no JSX renders it — dead code path. Add the toggle UI in Overview tab.
Server.py test_upload_policy_toggle_enforced side effect: /api/knowledge/upload now allows non-PDF uploads by demo user to reach the .pdf extension check (400) which is correct; verified.

Review request referenced 'tab-clients'/'tab-branding' as testids — actual admin tab testids are 'admin-tab-*' (admin-tab-overview/clients/activity/settings) while dashboard tabs are 'tab-branding'/'tab-matrix'. Naming is inconsistent between the two pages; consider standardising.
Frontend particle canvas has no data-testid — the review request itself acknowledged this. Consider adding data-testid='particle-canvas' for future test stability.
Booking confirm still ignores customer_email address format validation and always books tomorrow 15:00 UTC when no HH:MM parsed (carried over from iter3).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (1 missing UI element: upload-policy toggle group)

seed_data_creation: One TEST_admin.pdf uploaded and soft-deleted during admin upload test — self-cleaning. Demo user's avatar_background restored to 'studio_dark' post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 (Phase 7) — all new integration wiring (Telnyx/SES/Google OAuth) verified as graceful-degrade endpoints with empty keys, exactly as intended. Only one UI gap remains: Admin.jsx Overview tab needs to render the upload-policy toggle group (state exists, JSX missing). Once E1 adds those 3 data-testids, this iteration is fully green. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (9 tests, ~6s runtime). Fal wallet still exhausted → dicebear SVG fallback for avatars remains expected.
